items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: I remember June Clark, but I don't remember him being with Ellington.

ctx.x: Well, while we're on various musicians, while we're on Duke Ellington, do you remember June Clark, who played with Ellington for a short time?
Well, I remember June Clark, but I don't remember him being with Ellington. I guess he had been. I remember June Clark...
